verified_by: read directly from the Secretary of the Commonwealth's Lobbyist Public Search, in a browser session
source: Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth, Lobbyist Public Search
why_no_updater: The Secretary blocks server-side fetches, so no workflow can refresh this. It is read by hand from a browser session, which is the same constraint data/ma-lobbying-firms-latest.json lives with.
filing_cycle: Semi-annual. The Jan 1 - Jun 30 report is due Jul 15; the Jul 1 - Dec 31 report is due Jan 15. As of 2026-10-21 the first-half 2026 filing is the newest that exists; second-half 2026 cannot be filed until January 2027.

mira.name: Massachusetts Immigrant and Refugee Advocacy Coalition, Inc.
mira.scope_evidence: The registration names the bills directly: An Act to protect the civil rights and safety of all Massachusetts residents (S.1681, H.2580) and An Act ensuring access to equitable representation (S.1127, H.1954), plus budget legislation and executive-branch policy benefiting immigrants and refugees.
mira.no_registration_note: A broad search of registration year 2021 for any name containing 'Immigrant', all account types, returned no records. ACLU-MA's 2021 filing is present in the same registry, so 2021 data exists and MIRA's absence is a non-registration, not a gap.
mira.salaries_only_discrepancy: duncanburns2013-dot/The-Invasion reports $87,548 for 2022-2025 salaries only. Reading each year from the registry gives $86,971.60, a difference of $576.40. The registry figures above are what its own summary pages state; the source of the earlier number's extra amount has not been identified.
mira.prior_years_verification: Each year read from the Secretary's own summary page on 2026-10-21. Note the entity is filed as 'Massachusetts Immigrant and Refugee Advocacy Coalition' (no 'Inc.') in 2020 and with 'Inc.' from 2022 -- a name-variant that would hide the 2020 filing from an exact-name search.

aclu.name: American Civil Liberties Union of Massachusetts, Inc.
aclu.scope: all civil liberties and civil rights
aclu.scope_warning: NOT immigration-specific. ACLU-MA's registered purpose covers all matters related to the protection and advancement of civil liberties and civil rights. Do not describe this as immigration lobbying -- the registration does not support it. MIRA's does.
aclu.prior_years_verification: All six years read from the Secretary's own summary page on 2026-10-21, one search per registration year -- the registry has no year selector on the detail page. Every figure matched the totals carried in duncanburns2013-dot/The-Invasion, which had been transcribed from PNG page renders. Salaries, firm payments and expenses reconcile to each year's stated total.

verification_note: Every 2026 figure above was read from the Secretary's own summary page on 2026-10-21 and matched, to the cent, the figures carried in duncanburns2013-dot/The-Invasion, which had been transcribed from PNG page renders. Salaries, entity payments and expenses each reconcile to the published totals, and the named lobbyist amounts sum to the salary line in both cases. One name was initially dropped from the ACLU list -- Laura Rótolo, $12,500 -- because an accented character defeated the pattern used to read the page. The reconciliation check caught it: the named amounts summed $12,500 short of the registry's own salary total. Every list here now sums to its stated total. Prior years 2020-2025 were subsequently verified the same way on the same day; all six reconcile.
